name: 5 Card Omaha
description: 5 Card Omaha: five hole cards each, five community cards. Use exactly two hole and three board for best five-card hand. Pot Limit or No Limit. 2-9 players.

overview.description: 5 Card Omaha: five hole cards each, five community cards. Use exactly two hole and three board for best five-card hand. Pot Limit or No Limit. 2-9 players.

history.origins: Omaha poker is a modern casino variant that emerged in the USA in the 1980s, quickly spreading through card rooms and tournaments. Five Card Omaha (Big O) extends standard four-card Omaha by dealing five private cards to each player while keeping the "exactly two hole and three board" rule.
timeline: 1980s: Omaha poker introduced in US casinos and card rooms.
1990s–2000s: Omaha High, Omaha/8, and Five Card Omaha (Big O) spread to tournament series and mixed-game lineups.
Modern era: Big O appears in casino cash games, home games, and online poker rooms.

setup.dealing: Five hole cards each; five community cards (flop, turn, river).

rules.objective: Make the best five-card hand using exactly two hole cards and three board cards. Win the pot at showdown.
rules.gameplay: Preflop betting; flop (3); turn (1); river (1). Betting after each. Must use exactly two of your five hole cards and three community cards. Pot Limit or No Limit.
keyRules: Five hole cards; five community cards
Use exactly two hole and three board

strategy.basic: Play hands that can make strong combinations with two cards; more selection than Omaha (4 cards) but must use exactly two.
strategy.intermediate: Position and starting hand selection; avoid hands that need three board cards to connect.
strategy.advanced: Equity calculations with five hole cards; blocker effects; pot control.
tips: Exactly two hole and three board - no more, no less.
More flexibility than 4-card Omaha; tighter than Hold'em.
Draw-heavy boards favour multiple drawing hands.
